summary: The homology clause can be tested from public sequence and structure records (UniProt P05030 PMA1_YEAST, 918 aa; Xenopus atp6v1a entries; PDBe structures 7vh5/7vh6/9ugb/9ugc), but the identity of the yeast pump used in the tail experiment is unconfirmed in what I fetched. The tail-regeneration rescue counts and voltage measurements are not deposited anywhere I found.
next_step: Read the Adams et al. 2007 methods to name the yeast pump construct, then fetch matching Xenopus V-ATPase subunit sequences; the rescue data would have to be extracted from the paper figures.
